test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 4
solution:
The correct answer is "**were**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "Were" is the past tense of the verb "be" and is used for plural subjects or for the singular subjects "he", "she", and "it" in the past tense.
 
• In this case, the sentence is referring to something in the past, so the past tense "were" is more appropriate than "is" or "will
